tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje shugs kyi bsgrub thabs bzhugs//

"$ ༄༅// rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal nas// las dang sngags kyi nges pa bshad// 'khor lo'i dbus su pad ma la// zla nyi sgra gcan drag po bdud// mnan pa'i haṃ skyes khro bo che// gnam sngon lta bu'i lus po la// g.yas dmar g.yon dkar dbus nag zhal// rgyab zhal gser 'dra mgrin gsum pa// dpung par bcas pa'i phyag gnyis ljang*// khrag bcas glang po'i lpags pa 'dzin// lhag ma dus kyi 'khor lo 'dra// sna tshogs yum gyis mgul nas 'khyud// dpal gyi chas kyi rab tu 'bar// nyi ma bye ba'i gzi dang ldan// de ltar bdag nyid snyems byas nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal bskyed/ oṃ ham̐ kro ta ham̐ kro ta nam̐ adzña dha ya kā swa hā/ de nas phyag rgya dgod de/ oṃ haṃ hāḥ bha ma dha k+ṣi ṇi/ kā rna yoḥ badz+ra kun dha li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ aḥka ru kā na thā+e/ badz+ra me kha lā+e/ badz+ra ka ṇa the kā+e hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ a aḥbā ma dha k+ṣi nā ka ra yor badz+ra ru tsa ko'u hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hāḥbā ma dha k+ṣi na ban dha yor badz+ra nu pu re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ hāḥbam̐ pan tsa a ka ra ma ha shu n+ya sa bha bā ma ha badz+ra shi ro ma ṇi shi ra si sarba a ge brarma hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ oṃ a dha na ri sha rā badz+ra an dha tsan tra badz+ra pad ṭo u dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ a āḥ sarba sa ḍa e ka tri sa ra sa bha bā badz+ra ya dzo pa pī ta kan dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes phyag rgya drug go /de nas glang lpags la sogs pa phyag rgya gzhan bzhi ni/ oṃ k+ṣaḥ dhur dhan tan bhi ma na k+ṣa yi kar bh+ya gh+ra tsa rmā ka ṭu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ k+ṣa tri shad swa ra sa pa ta ti hra sa dhi rga bya dza na swa bha be dhe'i d+ya ku la sha ta shi ra bhi rmyun dha ma lā+e ska dha a laṃ bh-i ni skan dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hi hri hū h+li pan tsa ska dha/ bhi shud dha so bh+ya be shi ra si ka pa la ma le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/

oṃ k+ṣa k+ṣā k+shī k+shī k+shar k+shirā k+shu k+shū k+shil k+shilā k+sho k+shā/ ha hā hi hī hri hrī hu hū h+li h+lī haṃ hāḥ sarba bhi ga nā bhi dha ri da ga tsa tsa rma pa ram̐ ṭa/ ra ga ta shra sa ta hū phreṃ/ mgo g.yas su bstan la sdig 'dzub dang bcas pas 'dzin pa'o// phyag rgya bcu'o// de nas phyag gi mtshon cha rnams kyi sa bon ni/ oṃ k+sha kro ta badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+shā badz+ra khar ge hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+shā tri shu la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+shā badz+ra kar ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣa badz+ra bā ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+shā badz+ra a gū sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+shā badz+ra dha ma ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+shā badz+ra mud ka ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+shā badz+ra tsag kra hūm̐ phaṭa/ o k+ṣā badz+ra kun dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+shā badz+ra dan da hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+shā badz+ra par shu hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa ni g.yas su mtshon cha dgod pa'o// oṃ ham̐ badz+ra ghan ḍa ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badz+ra khe ta ka ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badz+ra khwa ṭ+wām̐ ga ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badz+ra ka pā la ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badz+ra pa tsa la ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badz+ra pa sha ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badz+ra rad na ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badz+ra pad ma ho phreṃng phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sham̐ kha ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badz+ra dhar sa ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ badz+ra shri kha la ho phreṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ham̐ tsa tu pe ta mu kha pa d+bā bā bh+ra ma shi ra ho phreṃ phaṭa/ ces g.yon gyi mtshon cha'o// de nas klu bcu dgod de/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dza ya nā gā ṇa ra badz+ra dza ṭa mu ku tra bhan dha tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ a ྐ sh+yu badz+ra bī dza ya na gen dh+ra badz+ra pa da bhan dhe tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ hra hrā badz+ra kar ko ta badz+ra pad ma ba ma de khyi na kun dha la yo tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ hraṃ hrā badz+ra ba su ki shaṃ kha ba lo ba ma dha k+ṣi na ru tsa ka tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ hram̐ hrā badz+ra a nan ta ku li ka me kha la ka ṇa thi kā yo tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/

oṃ h+li h+lī badz+ra ḍa k+ṣa ki ma ha pad mo ba ma da k+ṣi ṇa pa da nu bu re yo tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ de ltar sngags dang phyag rgya bkod// bgegs rnams thams cad tshar bcad cing*// bka' bsgo bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ 'phrin las bsgrub na bzlas pa bya// de nas rkang pa bcu drug pa mkha' 'gro ma dra ba dang ldan pa cig la/ gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i sngags 'di lta ste/ oṃ na mo badz+ra pa ta yā/ na mo bhud dha bā+o dhe sa twa bh+ya/ na mo badz+ra kro ten tra ra dze bh+yo/ na mo bi sha ma tre/ na mo bhud dha bo dhi swa twa de bi bh+yo/ na mo badz+ra dha ki ni bh+yo/ oṃ na mo bha ba ba te kā la tsaka kra ya/ badz+ra bā+ai ra ba bhi ka ra yā/ ma hen tra ni la rba rba sha ra yā/ ma ra ke kle sha hri da yā tran ta sha ta ra ga ta tsha ra na yā/ kri sh+na ra ga ta shi ta kan ṭh+ra yā/ ni la si ta pi ta/ ra ga te/ dam̐ ṣ+ṭha ka ra le a ta/ bhi sha na mu kha yā/ kri sh+na ra ka ta si ta pam̐ bhe ta ra kan dha yā/ ha hu da sha bhu dzā yā/ ṣa ṭa bi shad ti ka ra yā/ badz+ra kha rgam̐ tri shu la/ ka ti ka ba ṇa/ a ghu sha ḍa ma ru ka/ mud ka ra/ tsa kra kun dha/ dhan dha pa ra shu/ badz+ra ghan dha/ khe ṭa ka kha ṭam̐ ga ka pa la/ tsa pā/ pa sha/ ra na/ ka ma la shaṃ kha ar dhar sha pri kha la/ rba ma shi ro/ ga dza ya rma dh+yi ta ka ra ya/ bha gh+ra tshar ma ba sa na yā/ shan dhe mu ḍa ma la a ba laṃ bhi ne/ shi ra pri badz+ra pa tra mu ku te/ badz+ra ka pa la mā la a dha tsan tra dha ra yā/ kun dha la/ ru tsa ka/ kan thī ka/ me khā lā/ nu bu ra/ bha sma/ ya dzo pa bi ta/ shi ro ma ṇi/ ma ha mu tra nā gen ta/ bi bu sha na yā/ badz+ra dha ki ni/ san to shi ta hri ta ya yā/ in tra/ ag ne/ ya ma/ ni ri t+ya/ ba ru ṇa/ ba yu/ ku be ra/ i sha ra/ bra rma/ bi sh+ṇa bī na yā/ kar ti ke yā/ nan ti/ ma hā ka lā/ gh+ra hā/ na k+ṣa tra k+ṣe ṭu pa la/ su ren tra/ a su ren tra/ pha nin tra/ bhun ten tra/ na ren tra/ sam̐ stu ta/ ra tsa nā yā/

zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis sngags rkang pa bcu drug po 'di bye ba bzlas pas las thams cad grub bo// dngos grub chen po brgyad ni/ sbyin bsreg 'bum phrag bcus 'grub bo// sngon du bsnyen pa'i nges pa'o// de nas klags pa tsam gyis las thams cad byed do// bcom ldan 'das kyi phreng ba'i sngags so so'i yan lag brjod de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣa ma la ba ra yā/ ha kā la tsatra/ dur dan ta/ dha na mā ka/ dzā ti dzā ra ma/ ra na a nan ta ka/ hro lo kya bi dza yā/ ma ha bi re sha ram̐/ badz+ra bhe ra ba/ badz+ra ka yā/ badz+ra gā tra/ badz+ra ne ra/ badz+ra so tra/ badz+ra gha ṇa/ badz+ra dzi ba/ badz+ra dan ti/ badz+ra na ga badz+ra ka sha/ badz+ra lo ma/ badz+ra a bha ra na/ badz+ra ha sa/ badz+ra gi ta/ badz+ra n+yir d+ya/ badz+ra yu dha ka ra/ badz+ra kro dha ka ra dza/ ati pa ti/ badz+ra dha ka/ badz+ra dha ki ni dzā lā pa ri bri ta/ shri gham̐ a ghad tsha/ badz+ra sa ta adzña ye sarba mā rā bhi gha nā bi na yā ka ki na ra ki phu ru ṣa/ gha ru ṭa/ ghan dhar d+bhe/ ya k+ṣa/ rak+ṣa s+ya/ bhu ta/ ma hā pre ta/ ku sman dha/ a pa sma ra/ k+ṣe pra pa la/ ba twang ṭa/ pū ta na du ṭu na ga gra ha/ da yo ye sarba dza ra sarba/ bh+ya dh+yi/ sh+ni tri ba tra pa kā ri ṇa/ sarba sa twa nam̐ sarba a pa ka ra tā nan dza/ shwi gh+ram̐ badz+ra a ghu shā nā kri ṣu ur dha dhe shi ga tā nā kri sh+ya kri sh+ya/ pur rba di shi gā tā nām̐ kri sh+ya kri sh+ya/ u da ra di shi ga tā nā kri sh+ya kri sh+ya/ pas tsi ma de shi ga ta nā kri sh+yā kri sh+ya/ bha ya bha re shi ga ta nā kri sh+ya kri sh+ya/ ir sha na deng shi ga ta nā kri k+ṣu kri k+ṣu/ ni re dhi shi ga tā nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ ag na ya de shi ga tā nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ a ta de shi ga tā nā kri sh+ya kri sh+ya/ a kasha maṇa dha la ga ta nā kri ṣ+ya kri ṣ+ya/ ba yu man dha la ga tā nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ te dzo man dha la ga dha nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ u ta ka man dha la ga tra nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ pri thi bi man da la ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/

ka ma dha tu ka ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ ru pa dha tu ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ a ru pa dha tu ga ta nā kri ṣu kra ṣu/ ka ya dha tu ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ bag dha tu ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ tsid ta dha tu ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ pañtsa skan dha ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ pañtsa dha du gha ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ pañtsi in tre ya ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ pañtsa bī sha ya ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ pañtsa karma in hre ya ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ pañtsa karma wi sha ya ga ta nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ sarba to ya tra ku tra tsa twa nā kri ṣu kri ṣu/ ma ha sma sha ṇi/ badz+ra ag ni dz+wa li ta bu myaṃ ni pa ta yā pa ta yā/ badz+ra pa she na sarba bhu dzi shu bhan dha yā bhan dha yā/ badz+ra pring kha la yā sarba bad de shu ni ro dha ni ro yā/ sarba sa te ṣu ka yā bag tshid do pa tra pa tra ra tan tā na ma ho na tan na/ ma ha kro dha badz+ra tsu rna pa yā/ tsur rna pa yā/ badz+ra kha rga na ni trin ta yā ni trin ta yā ni/ badz+ra kri shu len bhe da yā bhe da yā/ badz+ra kar ti kā pa ha nā ha na/ badz+ra ba ṇe na bhin dha bhin dha/ badz+ra ki la kā+e ki la yā/ badz+ra mud ka ra na a ko ṭa yā a ko ṭa yā/ badz+ra tsag kra na tshe dha yā tshe dha yā/ badz+ra kun dhe na bin dha yā bin dha yā/ badz+ra dan dha na ta ṭā yā ta ṭā yā/ badz+ra par shu na tsi dha ya tsi dha yā/ sa dha tri kro ṭi khan tro kir ta so sha na bhu ma/ sarba bhu ta bh+yo/ bha li ma ku ru ku ru/ badz+ra dharma ru gā na badz+ra dha ka ni rā bha ha yā bha hā yā/ badz+ra dha ki ni bh+yo mā rā ka yi nam̐/ ru dhi ram̐ ni bhe dha ya ni bhe dha ya ni/ pan tsa armi ta ni be dha ya ni bhe dha yā/ sarba badz+ra dha ki ni sa hi taḥ sarba sa twa nam̐ shan ting ka phu+o ṣ+ṭi kam̐ rak+ṣa ba ra nam̐ gu pa ta ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ phreng sngags yan lag bcas pa 'di// bdud dang 'byung po'i gnod pa rnams/ lan bdun gyis ni bzlog par byed// sngon du bzlas pa bye ba byas// de yi bcu cha sbyin bsreg ste// so so'i las la 'bum phrag bcu// sbyin bsreg 'bum phrag gis 'grub 'gyur// phyi rol zla ba bcu gnyis la// 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis phye zla// nang du g.yas g.yon 'pho ba'i rlung*// dkyil 'khor drug cu'i bzlas pa yin// gzhan yang lha rnams kun gyi sngags// sku yi rdo rje spangs nas ni// dang por gnas pa'i yi ge rigs// dbyangs dang gsal byed gang yin pa// rang ming 'byung ba'i bye brag gis// dbyangs yig sgra gyur srog 'phrog cing*// gsal byed sgrar bsgyur nad bsogs byed// btang snyoms byed pas yun rings 'gyang*// mdza' bor gyur pa yon tan 'thob// sa rlung dgrar gshed me chu sgra// sa chu mdza' bo rlung me snyoms// me rlung mdza' bos sa chu snyoms// yi ge so so'i 'byung ba ni// dbyangs 'char nas ni bshad pa bzhin// nam mkha' ye shes kun gyi grogs// gzhan yang sngags kyi bsgyur byed ni// nam mkhas bsnun cing rlung gis 'bebs// me yis bsreg cing chu yis tshim// sa yis dgyes shing ye shes kyis// ro mnyam byed pa'i sngags rig bya// 'di ni rgyal bas sngon bstan to// gang rgyud sde so sor las gsungs pa'i lha la sogs pa rnams kyang rung ste/

chu yig las skyes pa'i lha dkar po pad ma'i phyag mtshan can sngags na ma'i mtha' rten dang bcas pa ni zhi ba'o// de nyid la cung zad ser ba dang bcas pa rab tu dgyes shing rgyas pa'i lus can swa hā'i mtha' can rgyas pa 'grub bo// me yi yig ge las skyes pa kha dog dmar ba dang rab tu dmar ba sgeg cing chags pa'i rnam pa can lcags kyu dang mda' dang rin po che la sogs pa 'dzin pa bhau ṣa ṭā dang ba shad tra dang*/ hri dza la sogs pa'i mtha' can gyis dbang dang dgug pa'i las 'grub bo// sa'i yi ge las byung ba mdog ser ba dang rab tu ser ba brjid cing brtan pa'i gzugs can lcags sgrog dang 'khor lo phur bu la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa staṃ bha dang mo ha ya dang laṃ nan la sogs pa'i mtha' can rigs pa dang rmongs pa dang mnan pa dang phur bus gdab pa 'grub bo// rlung gi yi ge las byung ba nag cing 'jigs pa'i gzugs can ral gri dang gri gug g.yo ba'i mtshan ma 'dzin pa ma ra ya phaṭa dang u tsa ta ya sogs pa'i mtha' ni gsad pa dang bskrad pa 'grub bo// nam mkha' dang ye shes kyi las byung ba rnam pa kun dang ldan pa'i sna tshogs mdog can dang nam mkha' lta bu de nyid kyi sngags dang ldan pa gso ba dang las thams cad pa byed do// phreng ba yang zhi ba la shel/ bskrad pa la mu tig bsad pa la mi rus/ bskrad pa la bong bu'i rus pa/ dbang la bo dhe tse/ dgug pa la pad ma'am tsan dan dmar po/ rmongs pa la lung thang*/ rengs pa la ru rag sha'o// de bzhin du 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga yang*/ zhing sa rgyas la n+ya tro ta'i 'dab ma la bsil ba dang ldan pa'i bsnyug gus snod khab phor du da ra ba nu ma dang bcas te zla bas bskol ba dang glang po che'o// bsad bskrad la ro ras la dug khrag gis bya rog gi sgros bris te thod par yi dwags dang rnga mo la'o// dbang dgug la gro ba la gur gum dang ghi haṃ gis gser gyi smyug gu ste/

pra tshil dang bcas pa'i ri dwags dang rta'i lus la'o/ rengs pa dang rmongs pa a ka'i 'dab ma la ba sla dang bcas pa'i snyug gus so phag dang bcas pa ra lug gam rus sbal gyi lus la'o// srad bu yang so so'i kha dog go// mdor na rgya chen bstan mod kyi// 'dir ni nyer 'kho bsdus pa yin// ro langs bya khyung bsgrub pa dang*// ral gri mig sman ri lu dang*// char dbab la sogs 'phrin las rnams// so sor bsgrub par bya ba'am// rdo rje'i shugs kyi bde blags bsgrub// las dang sngags dang lha so so'i// nges pa bstan pa rang byung rdo rje yis sbyar ba'o// sems can thams cad kyis mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob par gyur cig// /
